title: Entered a joint-venture partnership with Danone in 1996
statement: Entered a joint-venture partnership with Danone in 1996, initially hailed by Forbes as a 'showcase' joint venture.
outcome: Following Zong's death on February 25, 2024, his daughter Zong Fuli (Kelly Zong) inherited a 29.4% stake and took over as chairwoman/CEO in 2024, but stepped down in September 2025 amid an escalating dispute over Wahaha brand rights with other shareholders and an inheritance lawsuit from three people claiming to be her half-siblings, who obtained a Hong Kong court freeze on a $1.8 billion HSBC account in August 2025; Xu Simin succeeded her as legal representative, chairwoman, and general manager per corporate filings reported in late November 2025.

title: Reneged on a December 2006 agreement to sell a majority stake in
statement: Reneged on a December 2006 agreement to sell a majority stake in Wahaha's non-JV operations to Danone, triggering formal legal disputes in 2007.
outcome: Danone and Wahaha suspended their legal battle on December 21, 2007 and resumed negotiations; in 2009 Danone exited the joint venture entirely, selling its 51% stake back to Wahaha Group for an estimated $500 million.
